title: Payment
startLead: Check the amount, beneficiary and still-valid preparation before authorising the payment to start.
listLead: View your private attempts and statuses reported by the server. Payment, order, stock and refund are tracked separately.
providerUnconfigured: Payment is not yet available for this shop. You can review your preparation.
providerDetailsUnavailable: The amount or beneficiary cannot be confirmed. Starting payment remains unavailable.
consent: I authorise starting this payment for the displayed amount and beneficiary. A pending request or provider return does not confirm settlement.
readyExpired: These payment conditions have expired. Reload the conditions before giving new consent.
expiringSoon: These payment conditions expire on {{date}}. Start the payment before then, or reload them: nothing is extended automatically.
expiringSoonReserve: The reservation expires on {{date}} and cannot be extended: start the payment before then; afterwards, you will need to prepare again.
existingAttempt: An attempt already exists for this preparation. Check its status before taking another action.
uncertain: The result of this request is still unknown.
searchFirst: First look up the result with the server. Do not start another payment to bypass the wait.
providerActionLead: The server reports that action with the provider is required. You choose whether to open it; this does not confirm payment.
providerActionUnavailable: The provider action cannot be opened. Check payment status.
returnNotice: Returning to ANTSIA does not confirm settlement. Only the status verified by the server is authoritative.
fulfillmentUnconfirmed: Payment alone does not confirm collection or delivery. Check the order status.
sellerSettlementNotice: The payment status does not confirm a payout to the seller.
reviewHint: The server reports a situation requiring review. Do not initiate another payment while awaiting resolution.
lateSuccess: The server reports a payment confirmed after the reservation deadline. Availability and the next order steps require reconciliation.
doublePayment: The server reports a duplicate payment. Check its handling and any refund; no refund is assumed.
refundLead: A request will be sent for this payment. It does not constitute approval or a completed refund.
refundConsent: I explicitly request a refund of this payment for the selected reason and understand that approval and execution must be confirmed.
refundUnavailable: A refund request is currently unavailable for this payment.
refundNoGuarantee: Submitting a request guarantees neither approval nor a refund timeframe.
refundVersionConflict: This payment’s status has changed. Check its status before confirming a refund request again.
actionFailed: The response could not be confirmed. Look up the status before resuming the same attempt.
actionRefused: This action is currently unavailable. No new settlement is confirmed.
pageScope: Up to {{count}} payments are displayed per page.
noAutomaticCharge: No new payment is started automatically.
